title: Lesson
description: A markdown lesson. File: assets/content/<module>/<family>/lessons/<nn>-<slug>.json (family lesson) or assets/content/<module>/lessons/<nn>-<slug>.json (module-level lesson such as 'How the selection works'). The body is either inline or a reference to sibling .md files. Callouts: GitHub-style blockquotes `> [!TIP]`, `> [!TRAP]`, `> [!EXAMPLE]`, `> [!METHOD]`; a `> [!EXAMPLE]` whose content is a numbered list is a worked example revealed step by step (US-043).

familyId.description: Omit for module-level lessons (selection overview, exam-day tips).

order.description: Position in the family's table of contents.

summary.description: One sentence for the lesson list.

body.description: Inline markdown. Use for short lessons (< ~40 lines); otherwise use `file`.

file.description: Markdown files relative to the module folder, e.g. english/lessons/01-tenses.fr.md.

difficulty.description: Optional: level of the material (1 = basics, 5 = advanced tricks).

practiceTags.description: Tags used by the 'Try it' button to pick items related to this lesson (US-041).

deckIds.description: Flashcard decks linked from the end of the lesson.
